ThingDef.label: Patroller
ThingDef.description: These are small self-propelled weapons owned by the EDF. Although armed only with a small built-in shotgun, each unit has low power, but they make good decoys if you have enough of them.

ThingDef.label: Speed Star
ThingDef.description: It is a self-propelled weapon that the Advanced Technology Institute calls a masterpiece. As its name SpeedStar implies, this machine boasts an incredible running speed, but it is not equipped with any kind of armament, so it is not expected to be a force to be reckoned with.

ThingDef.label: Vegalta
ThingDef.description: Vegalta is a bipedal battle machine operated by EDF. It has high running ability on its bipedal legs and the ability to fly for short periods of time with its thrusters. It can mount weapons on both hands and shoulders, and boasts high firepower and versatility.

ThingDef.label: NixA
ThingDef.description: Nix is a bipedal powered exoskeleton operated by EDF. It has high running ability on its bipedal legs and the ability to fly for short periods of time with its thrusters. It can mount weapons on both hands and shoulders, and boasts high firepower and versatility.

ThingDef.label: NixB
ThingDef.description: Nix equipped with a revolver cannon and anti-aircraft equipment. It is also suitable for ground combat, and it is said that most of the Nixs owned by the EDF are this B-type.

ThingDef.label: Nix Assault
ThingDef.description: Nix in its final mission specification. The drivetrain has been greatly strengthened, giving it unparalleled mobility, and the armor has become extremely thick. Although only a small number of Nix Assault were deployed at the end of the war, they still achieved significant results.

ThingDef.label: Barga
ThingDef.description: As its name suggests, the "Gigantic Unloader" Barga was developed as a giant crane, but due to a number of problems, it was put into dead storage without being used for its intended purpose. However, the appearance of a 40-meter class monster changed the situation, and the Barga was deployed on a trial basis to defeat the creature, for which conventional weapons were ineffective, and the results were so successful that it was put into mass production. Although this is the original model developed as a crane, the E1 alloy armor covering the entire body and the powerful servo mechanism are of a level that overwhelms existing weapons, so there is no problem in treating it as it is for combat use.

ThingDef.label: War Barga
ThingDef.description: The Barga redesigned as a weapon. The originally sturdy armor is now thicker and stronger, and its power has increased dramatically. Unlike the initial model, which was originally a civilian crane, it is now a completely military weapon.Since it has been redesigned as a weapon, it has also acquired a certain degree of mass production capability, and the EDF possesses several dozen units of this machine in preparation for the emergence of monstrous creatures.

ThingDef.label: Strike Barga
ThingDef.description: The Barga has been improved for ultimate combat capability. Its performance far surpasses that of War Barga, the base model, and it is the trump card in the fight against monsters.Although it boasts such tremendous performance that it is said to be invulnerable, it has inherited the common weaknesses of the Barga, namely its sluggishness and huge body, making it weak against fast opponents. No matter how sturdy they are, they need the support of infantrymen.

ThingDef.label: Hector
ThingDef.description: Large robots with sturdy armor and powerful armaments. Deployed as the main battle force, it overwhelms the enemy with its own armament.

PawnKindDef.label: Hector
PawnKindDef.description: General-purpose land combat type equipped with a particle machine gun. It is the most basic armed type of Hector, and suppresses the enemy with powerful barrage fire.

ThingDef.label: Hector
ThingDef.description: Large robots with sturdy armor and powerful armaments. Deployed as the main battle force, it overwhelms the enemy with its own armament.

PawnKindDef.label: Hector
PawnKindDef.description: Bombing type Hector equipped with a spark launcher. It carries out a ranged attack with bursting energy projectiles. It is a basic category of equipment along with the particle machine gun equipped type, but its threat level is much higher.

ThingDef.label: Hector
ThingDef.description: Large robots with sturdy armor and powerful armaments. Deployed as the main battle force, it overwhelms the enemy with its own armament.

PawnKindDef.label: Hector
PawnKindDef.description: Artillery type Hector equipped with a plasma cannon. It attacks at long range with long-range energy projectiles. They are intensively deployed to support the front line from the rear or to bombard important points such as supply centers.

ThingDef.label: Sentinel Hector
ThingDef.description: An elite, high-performance Hector. Also known as “Enhanced Hector”. His entire body is covered with the blue glow of an electromagnetic barrier, and his defensive capabilities have been greatly enhanced, as well as his armament.

PawnKindDef.label: Sentinel Hector
PawnKindDef.description: A suppressive Hector equipped with a particle Gatling gun. With its defense and great firepower, it breaks down the front line. Although not a common type of Hector, it has a high fighting power even as a single fighter, so it is necessary to have enough strength to intercept it.

ThingDef.label: Sentinel Hector
ThingDef.description: An elite, high-performance Hector. Also known as “Enhanced Hector”. His entire body is covered with the blue glow of an electromagnetic barrier, and his defensive capabilities have been greatly enhanced, as well as his armament.

PawnKindDef.label: Sentinel Hector
PawnKindDef.description: A gunnery hector equipped with a particle stream cannon. It is responsible for sniping important targets with its long-range and high-speed energy projectiles. Although not a common type, it has high combat power even as a single fighter, so it requires sufficient forces to intercept it.
